'''Kal-Reyon Laboratory''', also known as '''Kal-Reyon''', was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] and weapons manufacturer during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. One of the company's own executives leaked Kal-Reyon's cybernetics research onto the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Plug the Leak}}</ref>
